announcements.t: AUSOM ENTERPRISE LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Closure of Trading Window |SUBJECT: Trading Window-XBRL
Ausom Enterprise Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 |SUBJECT: Trading Window

Ausom Enterprise Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on September 24, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results. |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
